quizzes.title: Quizzes
quizzes.kindHint.single: Two to six options, one of them right.
quizzes.kindHint.multi: Two to six options, any number of them right.
quizzes.kindHint.true_false: A statement the person says is true or false.
quizzes.kindHint.order: Three to eight steps to put in their right order.
quizzes.kindHint.match: Two to six pairs: a term and what goes with it.
quizzes.kindHint.text: A short answer typed in; spelling variants accepted.
quizzes.kindHint.number: A number with a tolerance and a unit.
quizzes.modeHint.fixed: The same questions every time, in your order.
quizzes.modeHint.random: A fresh mix from the topics for each attempt.
quizzes.col.question: Question
quizzes.col.rightHint: Share of answers that were right, and how many answers
quizzes.err.same: Two of them say the same thing.
quizzes.err.oneRight: Mark exactly one option as right.
quizzes.err.someRight: Mark at least one option as right.
quizzes.err.noAnswer: Add at least one accepted answer.
quizzes.err.lettersOrDigits: An accepted answer needs letters or digits.
quizzes.bank.description: Every question your quizzes, checks and the question of the day draw from. Drafts and archived ones are never asked.
quizzes.bank.emptyBody: Write questions by hand, or let the tutor write them from a knowledge base page or a lesson.
quizzes.bank.changed: {n} questions changed | {n} question changed | {n} questions changed
quizzes.bank.inQuizzes: In {n} quizzes | In {n} quiz | In {n} quizzes
quizzes.editor.kindLocked: People have answered it, so its kind stays.
quizzes.editor.stepsHint: Write them in the right order; people see them shuffled.
quizzes.editor.pairsHint: People see the left side as written and the right side shuffled.
quizzes.editor.answersHint: Spaces, dashes, ‘°C’ and capital letters don’t matter.
quizzes.editor.toleranceHint: How far off still counts as right.
quizzes.editor.explanationHint: Shown once the person has answered.
quizzes.editor.previewHint: The options are shuffled again for every person.
quizzes.editor.problems: {n} things to fix | {n} thing to fix | {n} things to fix
quizzes.preview.description: A fresh draw, as a learner would get it now, with the right answers. Nothing is saved.
quizzes.preview.emptyBody: Add questions in use to the list, or pick topics that have some.
quizzes.drafts.title: Write questions from a text
quizzes.drafts.description: The tutor reads a knowledge base page or a lesson and writes questions about it. They wait in the bank as drafts until you check them.
quizzes.drafts.kindsHint: Empty: any kind that fits the text.
quizzes.drafts.topicHint: Empty: the page’s or the lesson’s topic.
quizzes.drafts.rulesOnlyHint: Questions made by rules from the text’s numbers, steps and terms.
quizzes.drafts.pickFirst: Pick a page or a lesson first.
quizzes.drafts.started: The tutor is writing the questions
quizzes.drafts.done: {n} drafts written from «{source}». | {n} draft written from «{source}». | {n} drafts written from «{source}».
quizzes.drafts.dropped: {n} left out (not in the text). | {n} left out (not in the text). | {n} left out (not in the text).
quizzes.list.description: Fixed lists or random draws from topics, with a pass mark, attempts and a time limit. Courses use them as steps, checks send them out.
quizzes.list.newBody: Name it and pick how its questions come; the rest is on its page.
quizzes.list.emptyBody: A quiz checks what people learned: a fixed list of questions, or a fresh draw from topics each time.
quizzes.quiz.title: Quiz
quizzes.quiz.name: Name
quizzes.quiz.topicsHint: Questions in use of these topics are drawn, spread over them.
quizzes.quiz.listHint: Asked in this order, unless shuffled.
quizzes.quiz.listRandomHint: Questions added to the draw besides the topics.
quizzes.quiz.listEmpty: No questions on the list yet.
quizzes.quiz.addQuestionsBody: Questions in use from the bank.
quizzes.quiz.shuffleOptionsHint: Steps and pairs are always shuffled.
quizzes.quiz.partialHint: Part of the points for an answer partly right (several right answers, order, pairs).
quizzes.quiz.waitHint: 0: they may try again at once.
quizzes.quiz.everyoneHint: Also anyone with it in a course or a check.
quizzes.results.hardestHint: The share of answers that were right.
quizzes.results.resetBody: Their attempts stay in the history but no longer count against the limit or the wait.
quizzes.results.emptyBody: Attempts of the people you see appear here; a manager’s own tries never count.
quizzes.attempt.title: {name}'s attempt
quizzes.checks.description: A quiz sent to the team every week or month, answered within some hours. Reminders at half time and two hours before the end; the results come to you.
quizzes.checks.formBody: Each round is a fresh draw when the quiz is random.
quizzes.checks.name: Name
quizzes.checks.within: {n} hours to answer | {n} hour to answer | {n} hours to answer
quizzes.checks.emptyBody: Ask the team the rules that matter, every week: the fridge, prescriptions, expiry dates.
quizzes.skills.description: Each person’s mastery of each topic, from their last twenty answers (the newest weigh most). Rated from three answers.
quizzes.skills.unrated: {n} answers: not rated yet | {n} answer: not rated yet | {n} answers: not rated yet
quizzes.skills.cell: {score} from {n} answers | {score} from {n} answer | {score} from {n} answers
quizzes.skills.emptyBody: The matrix fills up as people take quizzes, checks and the question of the day.
quizzes.tutor.description: The tutor watches the training and suggests what to do: who to assign a course, what lesson is missing, who could coach, who to thank. Each Monday it sends you a report.
quizzes.tutor.aiOffTitle: The tutor works where AI is on
quizzes.tutor.aiOffBody: Switch AI on in Settings to get its weekly report, suggestions and chat. Quizzes, checks and the matrix work without it.
quizzes.tutor.offBody: Switch it on on its page to get the weekly report and suggestions.
quizzes.tutor.noSuggestionsBody: The tutor looks again every Monday and after each check round.
quizzes.tutor.noReport: Nobody in your branches to report on yet.
quizzes.tutor.askOff: Asking the tutor needs AI switched on and the right to use it.
quizzes.chat.hint: It reads training, the knowledge base and points, as you may see them.
quizzes.chat.try1: Who needs help with the cold chain?
quizzes.chat.try2: Which topic is the weakest this month?
quizzes.chat.error.generic: No answer came. Try again in a moment.
quizzes.chat.error.ai_off: AI is switched off, or this month’s AI budget is spent.
quizzes.chat.error.unavailable: Claude can’t be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
quizzes.chat.error.refused: The tutor can’t answer that one. Ask it another way.
quizzes.chat.error.max_tokens: The answer got too long. Ask a narrower question.
quizzes.chat.error.invalid_output: The answer came out garbled. Try again.
quizzes.daily.title: Question of the day
quizzes.daily.body: On workdays each person gets one question in the bot and the app: from their weakest topic first, never one they saw lately.
quizzes.daily.on: Send the question of the day
quizzes.daily.onHint: Nobody gets one while on time off.
quizzes.person.title: Quizzes and skills
quizzes.person.daily: Question of the day, last 30 days: {asked} sent, {answered} answered, {right} right.
